svg.title: Illustration of MoEraser architecture and noise injection-restore tuning
svg.desc: Complete editable reconstruction. Base frames include the left erase/preserve module, the central MoEraser architecture, the NIR construction module, and the restoration module. Fire icons are first constructed as SVG and then mapped to confirmed SAM assets P002 and P001 at their source crop coordinates.

g.desc: Inventory: red dashed Erase frame and blue dashed Preserve frame surround a Text embedding projector above MoEraser; red target branch and blue anchor branch meet at MoEraser. A flame sits over the erased object at lower left, then is mapped to SAM P002.

Inventory: large rounded blue MoEraser architecture frame. Origin is the lower routing block; wiring conducts upward to experts, summation, alpha scale, then rightward to a gated linear unit with W_in, W_out, V and sigma nodes. The layout is horizontally balanced: router/expert path on left, GLU on right.

Inventory: text embedding projector combines with structured noise p_tar through a plus sign, then arrow down to corrupted projector; spider-web corruption marks appear at input and output sides. Symmetry basis is vertical flow from clean projector and noise into corrupted projector.

Inventory: a light green restoration area compares a corrupted projector branch through MoEraser with a clean projector branch through MoEraser*. Token rows and a red opposing arrow at the top indicate corruption/removal, while bottom rows label f_tar, f_anc and Noise. Fire and snow symbols mark target and anchor cues. The two branches are horizontally symmetric around the red central arrow.

g.desc: Original Figure Object: left fire over target branch; Constructed Element ID: fire_a_draft; SAM Asset ID: asset_sam_region_000056. The asset source crop [27,152,39,45] covers only the flame, not the surrounding dashed frame or arrows.

Original Figure Object: right restoration fire marker beside MoEraser; Constructed Element ID: fire_b_draft; SAM Asset ID: asset_sam_region_000055. The asset source crop [979,153,30,40] covers only the flame.
